question: Does pulling the goalie at an offensive-zone faceoff tie more games?
answer: No clear effect. After model adjustment, OZ-draw pulls tie +1.0 pts vs other pulls (CI -2.8 to 4.7).
findings: Down 1, OZ draw: 16.1% level at 60:00 vs 14.5% expected (n=435, median 2:16 left).
Down 1, on the fly: 12.7% vs 12.2% expected (n=1,320, median 1:46 left).
Goal for before the goalie returns: 13% after OZ draw, 12% on the fly.
Down 1 and 2 pooled: +0.1 pts (-2.0 to 2.3), n=3,258.
method: Outcome: level or ahead at 60:00, minus Markov-model expectation for the pull time (stay pulled). First even-strength pull per team-game; zone from a faceoff within 2 s of the goalie leaving. Bootstrap CIs.
data: NHL API play-by-play + shift charts, regular seasons 2021-22 to 2024-25, 5,248 games; 1,801 pulls down 1.
split_check: OZ-draw residual down 1: +3.7 pts in 2021-23, -0.5 pts in 2023-25.

chart.title: Level at 60:00 after a pull, by how it started
